x: Charlie Dickinson found the jarring conditions tough for 45 year-old bones but nevertheless had the beating of Alex Luce; Steve Hewes was out for the first time but not eligible to score, so it was left to Mikes Webb and Nouch to close in our team in the 80's.

Not just the old reliables, Graham Adams, Jim Estall, Roger Alsop and Phil Carstairs, but add to that list Bruce Barton, the new revelation Dave Beaver the much improved Alex Luce, and don't forget new second claim member Steve Hewes who will hopefully be scoring for us next season.

Not so far back, in his first scoring run for the Bels., Steve Hewes had made a blistering start that he was shortly to pay for. Going into the second lap the Thames man, now identified as 2nd-claimer Larry Matthews from Salford, made his break and forced open what began to look like a winning lead.

Ray Foley was next in - great to have him back - just ahead of Steve Hewes who this time listened to wise old harrier Charlie Dickinson and worked his way through instead of blasting it from the start.
